Name: AtraCore
Author: atravita
Description:
A centralized location for some helper utilities my other mods use.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Simply remove this mod from your Mods folder.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows. [b]Does not work on Android.[/b]

[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, all players should install.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AtraCore/docs/changelog.md]Changelog[/url]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AtraCore]Source[/url]
[/list]

All donation points for this mod go to [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com/]Against Malaria[/url]. Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
